verdict.line: You lose if you let Camille land Hookshot's knockup with Precision Protocol already active and no Blinding Dart up; you win if you poke with Toxic Shot from range and blind every engage she commits to.

brief.thesis: Camille's entire kill combo is Hookshot (E) knocking you up into a guaranteed Precision Protocol (Q) empowered auto — that guarantee is the whole threat, not raw damage. Teemo's Blinding Dart makes that follow-up attack miss even while you're in the knockup, so the trade pattern is: harass with Toxic Shot poison from outside 325 range, then blind the exact instant she commits E or recasts Q. That single interaction is why this sits at 53.2% over 1167 games rather than genuinely losing.

theirWindow.what: She gets a free, guaranteed empowered auto (and a delayed Q recast for even more damage) while you're stuck in the knockup — this is her only reliable burst window since she has no ranged poke.

yourWindow.when: the moment she commits E or activates Q
yourWindow.what: Land Blinding Dart immediately so her empowered attack whiffs outright, wasting both the cooldown and the bonus damage; she's now stuck at melee range with nothing to punish you for walking away.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: The 54% win rate start over 1060 games — the AP, mana, and HP regen let you spam Toxic Shot pokes and Blinding Dart without running dry while you out-sustain her early all-ins.

boots.why: 54.2% win rate over 437 games — the flat move speed is what actually wins the matchup, since your whole game plan is staying out of Hookshot's 800 range and Precision Protocol's 325 range.

core.why: The 42%-pick, 53.1%-over-386-games core start — attack speed and the proc let you poke and reset faster than she can close distance.
Burn damage stacks with Toxic Shot's DoT, turning every poisoned auto into sustained magic damage she can't shield away in full.
Completes the measured 53.1% build path, adding ability haste so Blinding Dart and Noxious Trap are up more often during her engage windows.

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards stacking poisoned autos on an isolated melee target — by the time Camille closes to attack range, three hits are already queued up for the burst.

summoners.why: 93.8% pick rate at 54.8% win rate — Flash lets you dodge the committed Hookshot angle entirely, and Ignite punishes her for walking up without sustain since she has no ranged poke to answer it.

playing.title: Poke with poison, not autos
playing.detail: Toxic Shot has no cooldown and applies damage on impact plus a damage-over-time — harass at your max auto range and walk away, letting the DoT keep ticking while you're already out of her 325-range Q.

playing.title: Blind her empowered auto
playing.detail: The instant Camille activates Precision Protocol for her bonus-damage next attack, land Blinding Dart so that attack misses outright, wasting her cooldown and the bonus damage entirely.

playing.title: Pre-blind before Hookshot lands
playing.detail: Hookshot knocks you up on landing, guaranteeing her follow-up auto — blind her the moment she commits to E so that guaranteed hit whiffs even though you're still in the knockup.

playing.title: Trap her dash lines
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has a 1-second cooldown and only 230 range, so pre-place traps near the walls she uses for Hookshot engages and retreats to catch her in the slow and damage right as she commits.

playing.title: Sprint before she locks in
playing.detail: Pop Move Quick's sprint the moment she shows Hookshot or ultimate intent — the burst speed isn't stopped by being struck for a short time, so it can carry you out of range even if she catches one hit.

playing.title: Reset with Camouflage
playing.detail: Stand still in a brush to go invisible when she's not actively threatening you, then use the Element of Surprise attack-speed buff on your next walk-up poke.

playing.title: Wait out her shield
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses shields her against magic damage briefly after she lands a basic attack on you — don't dump a burst combo right after she autos you, wait a couple seconds for the shield to expire first.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, boots, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning — the blind-the-empowered-auto tech, trap placement, and sprint timing — is my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Camille’s Hookshot (E)! Use Blinding Dart [Q] right before being stunned to prevent her from dealing damage afterwards.
